compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a "Categories" section with three main tabs at the top: "SMS," "Jokes," and "Videos." The "SMS" tab is currently selected, indicated by the pink underline. Below the tabs, there are various categories represented by icons and labels. These categories include:

1. Character
2. Wishes
3. Events
4. Emotions
5. Funny
6. Interesting
7. Popular
8. Birthdays

Each category likely contains SMS messages related to the respective theme. At the bottom of the screen, there is an advertisement banner promoting Google Play apps.
